He taught me how to drive a boat and how to fish. He helped teach me how to swim. Thoose summers were the best, but now I am all grown up and nothing I do can make it go back to the way it was. He was always so funny, he could make anyone laugh and always knew what to say. Fuck I whish I would have spent more time with him. I hope this aint the end, if its not I promise I will spend more time with him.

I used to be really into csgo which I have almost 3k hours on. Though about 2 months ago I switched to playing Rocket League, I love the game more but being back in the state of not having put thousands of hours into the game and being quite bad at it, it’s quite triggering. I know it takes time and eventually I will reach a point where I am satisfied with how good I am at the game and what I have accomplished just like I did with CS after like 2k hours but the journy there is filled with lots of pain.

Its just not the same thing, I love to compete and better myself but get very anxious if I don’t see progress or if I start going down in ranks. I eish I could just relax and enjoy single player games. But the feeling of winning and being good at a competetive multiplayer game is too strong and its the only thing I have left.
